title: VocalRefit
shortDescription: Practice pitch and vocal control with live graphs, piano notes and recordings.
fullDescription:
See your pitch, hear a piano reference and practice at your own pace with VocalRefit.

LIVE PITCH AND PIANO
• View note names, octaves, frequency and your distance from the target pitch.
• Play the touch piano to hear reference notes.
• Use portrait or landscape mode and hide the graph when you want more room for the keyboard.

VOCAL PRACTICE
• Follow scales, intervals and continuous pitch slides.
• Hold a steady note or listen to piano notes and sing them back.
• Practice relative loudness while keeping the same pitch.
• Observe vibrato rate and depth as practice reference values.
• Follow guided breathing, humming and rest phases.
• Set the metronome tempo, time signature, subdivisions and beat accents.

RECORDINGS AND ROUTINES
• Record, play back, seek within, rename and delete your recordings.
• Save a selected recording to a file or share it with another app after confirming the necessary rights.
• Build routines with your own sequence, starting notes, durations, repetitions and rest periods.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Practice and recording work offline. There are no accounts or ads. Microphone audio is analyzed on your device and is not sent to developer servers. Recordings and practice history stay in app storage unless you choose to export or share them. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data removes internal recordings and history, so export recordings you want to keep first. External policy and support pages require an internet connection.

Pitch and loudness readings are practice aids and can be affected by your microphone, background noise and sound from the piano. VocalRefit does not measure vocal health or provide medical diagnosis or treatment. Choose a comfortable range and volume, and stop if you feel strain or pain.
